notes.title: Demo of Our Other Game is Now Available
notes.notes:
Our other game, Unrest, is now available on Steam for everyone! Dive into the world of Unrest and experience a part of the adventure that awaits you. Try the demo during the week-long tower defense event and let us know what you think!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091920/

notes.title: Amok Runner at the Steam Scream Festival
notes.notes: We recommend not missing out on the big discount. We are delighted to share that Amok Runner will be on sale during the upcoming Steam Scream Festival, which is set to start soon and last for one week

notes.title: March 2, 2023 Hotfix (Optimization)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Reduced loading times when loading.
[*]Drop issues have been mostly fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfixes: February 22, 2023
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Chapter selection is added to the main menu.
[*]Fixed some issues about the HUD.
[*]Leaderboard player ranking info is added to the screen (bottom left).
[*]Side missions are improved, fixed some glitches.
[*]Improvements have been made for speeding up the loading screen.
[/list]

notes.title: First Planned Update Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added 3 unique side missions
[*]Till death mode improved
[*]Added 3 new achievements
[*]Added a new drivable vehicle
[*]Fixed several bugs
[*]Various performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: January 20, 2023 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added 'Till Death' mode.
[*]Added two separate leaderboards based on speedrun rankings and 'Till Death' mode scores.
[*]Improved gameplay.
[*]Fixed several bugs.
[*]Optimization improvements
[/list]

New side missions will be added soon.

notes.title: First Update Will Be Delayed
notes.notes:
Hi Amok Runner community
In order to present you a better gameplay experience, we will need a little bit more time before releasing the first planned update. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: 1.0.0.1 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Maximum frame rate disabled. (Note: Turn off vsync to effect)
[*]Several bugs fixed
[*]Optimized for drop fps when transition (Still working on this problem)
[/list]

notes.title: FIRST PLANNED UPDATE (06.01.2023)
notes.notes:
We are happy to inform you that the following new features will be added during the first week of January:
[list]
[*]Three unique side quests will be added.
[*] With the newly integrated "Till Death" mode, fend off wave after wave of dangerous Amok patients. With the points you earn here, claim your place on the leaderboard.
[*]Two new achievements will also be waiting for you.
[/list]
